recipe.title: Palak Paneer

ingredients.name: kasuri methi
ingredients.prep_note: (dried fenugreek leaves) (skip if you don't have)

steps.text: Pluck young tender spinach leaves and discard stems (use baby spinach stems if using baby spinach).
steps.label: Prep spinach

steps.text: Add spinach to a large pot of water, rinse well a few times and drain in a colander; allow water to drain completely.
steps.label: Rinse spinach

steps.text: Heat half tablespoon oil in a pan; sauté green chilies, cashews and spinach for 3 to 4 mins until leaves wilt and raw smell is gone.
steps.label: Sauté spinach
steps.doneness_cue: until the leaves wilt off thoroughly & raw smell of spinach has gone away

steps.text: Cool the sautéed spinach completely, then blend it with 1/4 cup water to a smooth thick puree (you may add 1–2 tbsp more water to help blending).
steps.label: Blend spinach
steps.doneness_cue: puree should be smooth and thick

steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon butter and half tablespoon oil in the same pan; once they melt add cinnamon, cardamoms, cloves and cumin seeds.
steps.label: Temper spices
steps.doneness_cue: when the spices begin to sizzle

steps.text: Add onions and fry till they turn transparent to golden.
steps.label: Fry onions
steps.doneness_cue: till they turn transparent to golden

steps.text: Saute ginger garlic paste for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
steps.label: Cook paste
steps.doneness_cue: until you begin to smell it nice

steps.text: Add tomatoes with salt and sauté until they break down and turn mushy.
steps.label: Cook tomatoes
steps.doneness_cue: until they break down and turn mushy

steps.text: Add garam masala and sauté until the masala smells good (this may take about 2 mins).
steps.label: Add garam masala

steps.text: Pour 3/4 cup water and cook covered until onions are completely soft (there should be some water left in the pan).
steps.label: Simmer onions

steps.text: Lower the flame, add kasuri methi and the pureed spinach; mix and cook until it begins to bubble for about 2 to 3 mins. Add a few tbsp hot water if the curry is too thick.
steps.label: Add spinach
steps.attention_cue: cook until it begins to bubble for about 2 to 3 mins

steps.text: Avoid overcooking; add paneer and mix well, then turn off heat and transfer to a serving bowl. Optionally garnish with cream.
steps.label: Finish dish

steps.text: Serve palak paneer with naan, roti, Basmati rice or Jeera rice.
steps.label: Serve

steps.text: [OR another option is to blanch the palak in 4 cups of hot water with ¼ tsp salt for 2 mins, then immerse in ice cold water and drain completely.]
steps.label: Blanch spinach (alt)
steps.role_cue: [OR another option is to blanch the palak in 4 cups of hot water with ¼ tsp salt for 2 mins. Then immerse in ice cold water. Drain completely.]
